enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Dry hands. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Open cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Pick up bowl. Drink milk. Place bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Adjust shirt. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone for time. Put phone in pocket. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace.

Walk into facility. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient: 'Good morning, how are you feeling?' Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Write notes. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Take break. Walk to break room.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Throw away trash. Walk back to work area. Check phone. Read book.

Walk into facility. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Write notes. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Take break. Walk to break room.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone for messages. Put phone in pocket. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Stand up. Get off bus. Walk home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Chop vegetables. Put vegetables in pot. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink.

Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV.
Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Type email. Send email. Open browser. Read news. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Wash face. Rinse face. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Sleep.
